rejections.reason: Combines the original rise in yields with the later reversal and substitutes a bond-price channel; direction and effect are not faithful to the source.
Omits that SPR sales are deducted from government consumption and that lower sales explain the quarterly accounting increase.
Cause label drops the decrease in SPR sales and effect label drops government scope. Excluded to avoid implying an increase in total consumption or a direct GDP effect.

limitations: Literal evidence matching does not verify the truth, sign, scope, horizon or transmission channel of a claim.
Horizon and confidence are model annotations, not independently measured causal timing or truth probabilities.
The remaining BEA item describes a component contribution, not identified economic causality.
Extraction used selected excerpts, not exhaustive reading of entire filings.
